meta.title: Quick switcher
meta.description: A unified search surface that switches sessions, browses workspaces, runs application commands, refills the input from sent prompts and answers to the agent's questions, jumps to a main panel such as Plugins or Automation tasks, opens workspace files in the Sidebar from @, and answers a side question about the current session from ?. A side question carries the full tool activity and the step that is still running; images and files can be turned off in Settings. Opens with Ctrl+Shift+K by default; input history is unbound.
